definitions.gloss: background knowledge; prior knowledge; preliminary knowledge
definitions.explanation: Knowledge that one has or needs before engaging with a particular topic, task, or situation. Often mentioned when discussing what is needed to understand something.

examples.japanese: {予備知識|よびちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: You can enjoy it even without background knowledge.

examples.japanese: {予備知識|よびちしき}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧な⟦{用語|ようご}→用語：04086_yougo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll explain the basic terms as background knowledge.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予備知識|よびちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{理解|りかい}できる→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧。
examples.english: You can understand this movie more deeply if you have some background knowledge of history.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{予備|よび}→予備：03993_yobi⟧ (preliminary, spare) and ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧ (knowledge). Commonly used in educational and media contexts to describe what readers or viewers should know beforehand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予備知識|よびちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have background knowledge)
- {予備知識|よびちしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to lack background knowledge)
- {予備知識|よびちしき}なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (without background knowledge)
- {予備知識|よびちしき}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as background knowledge)
